		if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m218_customer_score >= var:zg361_ip_m218_dual_floor var:zg361_ip_m218_foundation_score >= var:zg361_ip_m218_dual_floor } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_full_high_eligible value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_adoption_policy_used value = var:zg361_ip_m217_adoption_state }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_consumer_freeze_dual_score value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m218_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}
